makerFeeNote: Maker fees follow the official schedule: round_up(M x 0.0175 x C x P x (1-P)) for a resting order that ultimately executes, with M = the series' maker multiplier (0 for a series whose GET /series fee_type carries no maker fees, i.e. plain 'quadratic'; the series' recorded multiplier otherwise). IRR-41 closed 2026-09-22; gross and net numbers are both reported so historical runs stay comparable.
